source_scope.mosaic: frozen exact typed partition into 2CNF/HORN3/DUAL_HORN3 modules
source_scope.interaction_graph: connected simple module graph; variables occurring in more than two modules are rejected as interface hyperedges
source_scope.cycle_rank: >=2; forests and unicyclic instances remain predecessor authority

canonical_discovery.spanning_tree: deterministic BFS; neighbors visited in lexicographic order; first-discovery parent edge enters T
canonical_discovery.edge_separator: S_e is the exact set of variables shared by the two incident modules
canonical_discovery.important_scope_rule: Admission is based only on this deterministic canonical T and its discovered B. Existence of a different lower-width spanning tree is not claimed or searched.

admission.conditioned_tree_boundary: For every module, after removing variables in B from the boundary, remaining tree-boundary width <= floor(log2(max(2,L))).

candidate_mechanism.step_1: Discover canonical T, C and B exactly.
candidate_mechanism.step_2: Enumerate every sigma in {0,1}^B exactly; no sampling or heuristic pruning.
candidate_mechanism.step_3: Condition every module on sigma restricted to its variables.
candidate_mechanism.step_4: Delete feedback edges C; the remaining interaction is T.
candidate_mechanism.step_5: Run exact typed-module tree DP on T with conditioned B fixed globally.
candidate_mechanism.step_6_sat: If one sigma accepts, reconstruct a root witness and replay it against the original CNF before COMMIT_SAT.
candidate_mechanism.step_6_unsat: COMMIT_UNSAT only if every sigma is exactly rejected by the conditioned tree DP.

formal_semantics: SAT(F) iff exists sigma_B in {0,1}^B such that SAT(F conditioned on B=sigma_B).

proof_obligations.F1: Canonical spanning-tree, feedback-edge and B discovery is deterministic and polynomial.
proof_obligations.F2: Deleting C yields exactly the discovered spanning tree T.
proof_obligations.F3: Conditioning on all assignments to B is semantically exact for SAT.
proof_obligations.F4: For each fixed sigma_B, the conditioned typed-module tree DP is exact.
proof_obligations.F5: Accepted sigma_B reconstructs a globally consistent witness that verifies on the original CNF.
proof_obligations.F6: If every sigma_B is rejected, the original CNF is UNSAT.
proof_obligations.F7: Total construct + discover + solve + reconstruct + verify lifecycle is polynomial in L under the frozen admission bounds.

symbolic_complexity_target.rows_per_module_per_sigma: <= 2^w <= L for conditioned tree-boundary width w<=floor(log2 L)
symbolic_complexity_target.target_envelope: at most polynomial; a conservative M*L^2 native-solve-call envelope is acceptable if independently derived and checked

required_positive_falsifiers: at least one connected graph with cycle rank >=2 and canonical |B| within budget
SAT and UNSAT admitted instances when constructible
exact comparison with independent truth enumeration only on finite small controls
